audit_items.proof_trace: float::int_div(collateral_amount, exchange_rate) computes WAD * collateral_amount / exchange_rate.value using u256 integer division, which truncates toward zero (floor) for positive values, yielding exactly floor(amt / exchange_rate). Move's unsigned arithmetic guarantees this truncation, and exchange_rate.value is always positive (WAD when total_supply==0, or cash_plus_borrows_minus_reserves*WAD/total_supply otherwise), so no rounding-up path exists.
